_comment: Durn's build tutorial. The script is docs/STORY.md; the shape is measured off
Clash of Clans in docs/reference/COC_TEARDOWN.md, whose five rules this obeys:
1. never an empty screen — the village exists before the player does
2. one action available at a time, everything else dimmed
3. a reason to build the thing you are told to build
4. show the locks — what is coming is advertising, not friction
5. ask for nothing until you have given something
This is the BUILD tutorial only. The cinematic opening — the cart, the rain,
the sound in the Duskwood — is Phase 6 and lives in STORY.md until then.
say    what Durn says. Keep it to two lines at phone size.
goal   what the player must do before the next line arrives:
camera    move the view at all
finished  have a finished building of `id`
level     have a building of `id` at `level` or better
point  what the arrow points at: `card:<id>` or `building:<id>`, or nothing

steps.say: Right. Before anything else — drag the ground about, and roll the wheel. A builder who cannot see the site is no builder at all.
Now look down. Those straight lines under the grass are drainage cuts. Somebody farmed this, and farmed it well. Put a croft on it.
Aye. Now leave it alone. It will take four seconds, which is three more than you will want to give it.
Grain is no use in a heap. You will want timber, and the only good wood is at the treeline. That is not my problem today.
Now tap the croft. Everything in this holding can be made better than it is, and most of it should be.
Upgrade it. It will cost you, it will take longer, and it will pay more. You can see the numbers before you spend — I insisted.
That is the whole job, lad. Build it, wait for it, improve it. I will be over there, complaining about the drainage.
